title: 面向企业AI智能体部署前的保障：基于本体的仿真与信任认证
summary: 提出一种基于本体的验证框架，用于企业AI智能体部署前的保障。该框架包含操作包络、本体到场景生成管道和信任证书三个组件。在四个受监管行业的试点中，本体驱动生成相比基线方法实现了更高的监管覆盖率（48.3% vs 33.1%）和领域特异性（4.77/5.0）。
summary_en: Proposes an ontology-grounded verification framework for pre-deployment assurance of enterprise AI agents, combining an operational envelope, scenario generation pipeline, and trust certificate. A pilot across four regulated industries showed ontology-driven generation achieved 48.3% regulatory coverage vs 33.1% baseline and highest domain specificity (4.77/5.0).
